context: Documentary discussion: Asuka and Ren on a coming-of-age film.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: documentary discussion; vocabulary (少年/従来/向かっ/小泉/他人) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この映画、少年が主人公なんですね。
lines.en: This film has a boy as the protagonist.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、少年が夢に向かって歩みます。
lines.en: Yes, the boy walks toward his dream.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 従来の生き方とは、違うんですか?
lines.en: Is it different from conventional ways of living?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 従来の常識を、少年が破ります。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 時代は、小泉政権の頃ですか?
lines.en: Is it set in the Koizumi-government era?
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、小泉氏の時代が背景です。
lines.en: Yes, the Koizumi era is the backdrop.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 少年は、他人にも支えられますね。
lines.en: The boy is supported by strangers too.
lines.style: understanding young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 他人の優しさに、未来へ向かっていきます。
lines.en: With strangers' kindness, he heads toward the future.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
